title: The Quiet Well
author: Juniper Whitlock
blurb: Sebastian Vane, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
